Caben la mitad más de balas, así que rec: It holds half as many more bullets, so you reload less often. It is lost along with the weapon if you get arrested.
Cada coche, moto o camión tiene su depós: Each car, motorcycle or truck has its own tank and uses fuel as it moves, more the faster you go. It warns you when it enters reserve; with an empty tank, the engine stops. You refuel at gas stations without getting out of the vehicle, with a can bought there, or by calling roadside assistance from the phone, in Services. The V key tells you how much is left. It doesn't apply to boats, to anything that flies, to bicycles or to mission vehicles.
Cada delito cuenta la mitad más, así que: Every crime counts half again as much, so your wanted level rises sooner. Each active modifier makes you gain experience twenty-five percent faster.
Cada tipo de lugar suena de una manera c: Each type of place sounds a different way when you pass by. When you turn it on, a sample plays, the one for a bar. In the main menu, Learn the sounds has them all.
Cada vehículo cuenta los kilómetros que: Each vehicle counts the kilometers it travels. Every so often a tire goes flat: you can hear it, and the car won't go above half speed until you change it, with a spare from the phone, at a repair shop or by calling assistance. After a certain number of kilometers it is due for an inspection at a repair shop; if you skip it, the brakes get worse. The V key, while driving, tells you the kilometers and what is wrong with it.
Cada vez que aciertas a un enemigo o a u: Every time you hit an enemy or a vehicle, a high-pitched tap sounds and the gamepad gives a short jolt. When you lock onto a target with Q, the gamepad also alerts you.
Cada vez que el juego dice algo, el soni: Every time the game says something, the background sound and the music drop for a moment so it is easier to understand. Important effects, such as engines, footsteps and gunshots, do not drop.
Cambia cada opción con las flechas izqui: Change each option with the left and right arrow keys. F1 explains the option

Con el motor clásico, el juego prepara e: With the classic engine, the game prepares the sound in larger chunks. Sounds arrive a few hundredths of a second later, but clicks, dropouts and stuttering stop on low-powered computers or ones with delicate sound cards. Try it if the audio stutters; another fix is the surround engine. The change applies when you close and reopen the game.
Con el motor envolvente, los sonidos del: With the surround engine, world sounds carry the echo of the place you are in: little in the countryside and on the beach, some in the street, more among warehouses, long in the mountains and short and close inside a building. Also, things that fly sound overhead, and if you fly, the city sounds below you. With the classic engine this option does nothing.
Con el vuelo real. Con sí, cada aparato: With real flight. With yes, each aircraft has its own tank, which is filled at heliports, airports and airfields; the game warns you at reserve, and if it runs out, the engine stops and you glide. With no, the tank is never used up.
Con no, que es lo de siempre, los barrio: With no, which is the usual way, neighborhoods are conquered and defended from the phone, in Territories. With yes, every neighborhood in the cities belongs to a gang and its members walk its streets. A neighborhood is conquered by going there: when you take down two of theirs, or confront them from the phone once you are inside, the gang comes for you in three waves. Your own gang comes to help. You must not leave the neighborhood until it is over. And when a neighborhood of yours is attacked, you defend it by going into it. On an online server it doesn't apply: there, neighborhoods belong to the players' gangs.
Con poco, se quitan las frases que solo: With little, the sentences that only remind you which key to press are removed. With a lot, menus also read the explanation of each option, without pressing F1. Normal is the usual.
Which voice the game speaks with.
Con sí, al acercarte al campo de destino: With yes, as you approach the destination field the aircraft descends and lines up by itself, even if you fly by hand. With no, you do it yourself: you descend to the altitude the tower says and keep the alignment clicks centered; if you come in high or crooked, the tower sends you around again, and on the second try it guides you in. It can also be changed during the flight, in the flight menu.
Con sí, al coger un taxi o un autobús se: With yes, when you take a taxi or a bus you hear the ride for a while: the engine, the road and the radio. It lasts between twelve seconds and a minute depending on the distance, and with Enter you arrive right away. With no, you arrive instantly.
Con sí, al llegar al nivel 5 acude un he: With yes, at level 5 a helicopter shows up: you hear it arrive and circle above you, and it talks to you over the loudspeaker. While it has you located you can't shake the police. It loses you if you hug a wall for a few seconds or go into a building, and it doesn't recognize you if you change vehicles without it seeing you. It can be shot down with a rifle or an explosive, but then the police take twice as long to forget you and you pay for the helicopter when arrested. It makes level 5 quite a bit harder: that is why it comes turned off. On a server with shared police it doesn't appear.
Con sí, algún coche patrulla hace su ron: With yes, some patrol car does its rounds on the streets even if nobody is after you, as on online servers. They see the crimes you commit nearby, and with traffic rules on they are the ones who issue the fines. If you are attacked and one is nearby, it comes. With no, the police only appear when they are after you. On a server with shared police, the server runs them.
Con sí, aunque el contenido para adultos: With yes, even if adult content is turned off, Love life appears on the phone: people to meet, dates, gifts, being partners, getting engaged, living together and a simple wedding. With no adult content at all. With no, relationships only exist with adult content turned on, as before.
Con sí, cada detención y cada multa que: With yes, every arrest and every fine you pay an officer goes on your record, more serious the more you were wanted. A criminal record closes off positions of trust, joining the police and, if serious, loans; and every crime counts a bit more while you are on file. They expire by themselves: minor ones after {entero} days, medium ones after {entero2} and serious ones after {entero3}, and they can be reduced with community service or a lawyer. What you did before this version doesn't count. With no, nothing is recorded, as before.
Con sí, cada {entero} días te cobran la: With yes, every {entero} days you are charged for the electricity and water of your homes, their property tax and a tax on what your businesses have earned, and now and then an inspection visits one of them. The amounts are small, they are announced {entero2} days ahead, charged automatically and can be checked on the phone. If the money isn't there, it is owed with a surcharge; after {entero3} missed payments, part of what you earn is seized until it is settled, but nothing is ever taken from you all at once. A game already in progress gets {entero4} days of grace. With no, there are no bills, taxes or inspections, as before.
Con sí, cuando el servidor en el que jue: With yes, when the server you play on restarts to update, or the connection drops, the game doesn't send you back to the menu: it waits, with your game as it was, tries to rejoin every few seconds and, when the server is back, you carry on where you were: same place, same vehicle, same health, same weapons and same mission. It joins with your usual identity, without asking for anything. Escape stops waiting. With no, as before: you go back to the main menu and rejoin by hand.
Con sí, cuando pasas la noche con alguie: With yes, when you spend the night with someone you decide what you do at each moment and the other person responds. Paying attention to what they want, and stopping if they ask you to, is what makes it go well. It is still told in a sensual way, without explicit scenes. With no, the night is told in a couple of sentences, as before.
Con sí, cuando tienes cerca el vehículo: With yes, when another player's vehicle with a game station tuned in is near you, you hear it faint and muffled, from where their vehicle is, and it fades as you move away. It only plays if you don't have your own radio on, and only one at a time. Nobody's own music is ever heard: nothing from My music leaves your computer, only which game station you are tuned to is sent. With no, you don't hear anyone's radio; others still hear yours.
Con sí, después de hablar contigo una pe: With yes, after talking to you a person may do something on their own, depending on their character and how much they trust you: come along with you for a while if they like you, punch you if you keep at it after offending them, or report you if you insult them. The game decides, without artificial intelligence. With no, people only talk, as before. Asking for a favor and asking someone to join your gang are always in the conversation, because you choose those.
Con sí, en la ficha de tu pareja aparece: With yes, your partner's profile gets the option to ask them to move into one of your homes. Each person decides: some accept when the relationship is going well, and others won't leave their home for anyone. If they accept, you find them at home, they cook for both of you or ask you to cook, they ask you for things now and then and notice if you don't show up. You can ask them to leave. With no, which is the default, each of you stays in your own home. New plans as a couple don't depend on this option. Single-player only.
Con sí, en las comisarías puedes ingresa: With yes, at police stations you can join the police and, once an officer, start a shift: you get a patrol car and the radio gives you alerts about robberies, fights, reckless drivers and chases. You resolve them by ordering a stop, slowing them down, arresting or fining, you get paid for each one and you get promoted. On duty, force against suspects is not a crime; any other crime costs you a reprimand or your badge. With no, which is the usual, none of this appears. Single-player only.
Con sí, las escenas de las misiones suen: With yes, the mission scenes play with a different voice for each character, instead of your screen reader reading them, and the text still goes to braille. They call you by the name of the character you play and speak to you in masculine or feminine, depending on what you chose. Any sentence without a voice is said by your screen reader. With no, everything is said by your screen reader or, if you don't use one, by the Windows voice.
Con sí, las personas de tu vida social s: With yes, the people in your social life are dealt with face to face: a date, a gift in person, a kiss, the night or asking them out, where that person is, at your home if you live together, or while they are with you. From the phone you call, write, meet up somewhere at a set time, send a gift to their home, give money and break up. A date is lived by going to the place together. With no, everything is done from the phone, as before.
Con sí, que es lo realista, tus balas y: With yes, which is the realistic setting, your bullets and explosives hurt them: the dog becomes afraid of you until you make peace, and your crew puts up with two warnings before turning on you. With no, they can't be aimed at or hurt, not even by accident.
Con sí, si has puesto el movimiento en o: With yes, if you have set movement to other keys, menus can also be navigated with them. It helps, for example, if your screen reader takes over the arrow keys. When typing text the keys are always the normal ones. If you get confused, Reset the original keys puts everything back.
Con sí, si un atracador, un pandillero o: With yes, if a robber, a thug or anyone attacks you without you having touched them first, shooting or knocking them down doesn't count as a crime, nor does stopping the people in a street event. Also, if officers are nearby or a patrol arrives, they go after them too and not only you. It doesn't apply to mission enemies or to anyone you attacked first, and explosives are still a crime. With no, everything is as before: any shot and any casualty counts.
Con sí, un enemigo caído deja a veces en: With yes, a fallen enemy sometimes drops the weapon they carried on the ground, if you don't have it: you pick it up as you walk over it. It makes the game easier and the gun shop less necessary, which is why it comes turned off. On an online server it doesn't apply.
Con sí, un enemigo que llevaba un arma d: With yes, an enemy who carried a firearm like one of yours sometimes drops ammo for that weapon on the ground. It is picked up by itself when you walk over it on foot, like money, and a magazine sound plays. With no, they only drop money, as before.
Con sí, un helicóptero o una avioneta de: With yes, a helicopter or a light plane takes off, has altitude, which you raise with D and lower with A, and lands with F; and when you fly out of a town, or with Enter at a heliport or an airport, you make a real crossing to another one, with heading, altitude, wind, tower and approach. There is an autopilot and you can speed up. With no, it is as before: you always fly at the same height and switch towns in a jump from a heliport. The full explanation is at any heliport or airport, in How flying works.
Con sí, un rato después de un tiroteo o: With yes, a while after a shootout or a hit-and-run, an ambulance arrives with its siren, pulls up to the curb, the paramedics treat people and it leaves. It is ambience: it doesn't chase you, doesn't run you over and changes nothing. Single-player only.
Con sí, una pulsación de Mayúsculas te p: With yes, one press of Shift makes you run and another brings you back to a walk, without holding it. With no, you run while you hold it down.
Con toda tu banda y dos guardaespaldas,: With your whole gang and two bodyguards, missions played themselves. With this option, when you arrive at a mission with people at your side, a few more enemies await you, tougher and better aimed, depending on how many you bring. The first of yours doesn't count, and there is a cap so no mission becomes impossible. Moderate, which is the default: at most half again as many enemies. Strong: at most double. No: the same ones always await you. It doesn't apply in tutorials or on an online server. The game warns you when the opposition goes up because of your escort.
Con un arma en la mano. Salta la alarma,: With a weapon in hand. The alarm goes off, the warning reaches {dueno} and their gang, and you have to hold the door for twenty seconds, on foot and without moving away. If you manage it, you take the day's till, {ingresos} euros, which is deducted from them at midnight. Each business's till can only be emptied once a day.
Con un destino marcado en el GPS y en co: With a destination marked on the GPS and assisted driving, the car drives itself: it accelerates, brakes, turns, waits at traffic lights and stops on arrival. With any arrow key or Space, you take control. It also turns on with the Y key while driving.
Con uno o dos niveles de búsqueda y dine: With one or two wanted levels and enough money, when an officer catches you, you can pay the fine on the spot, try to bribe them or let yourself be arrested. With no, you are always arrested, as before.

Cuánto pesa en el mundo cómo te ven los: How much it matters in the world how the neighbors and the street see you. Off: everything as in earlier versions; standing only counts for pay, the bank and the police. Mild, which is the default: in stores they give you discounts if they like you, up to {entero} percent, and let you buy on credit; where you are avoided they charge a bit more; neighbors sometimes cover for a minor offense; a business that is looked after earns more and a neglected one a bit less; without street reputation or an escort, some gang may ask your business for money; and if you live a double life, what becomes known can end up in the newspaper. Normal: the same at full strength, and with a bad reputation or a criminal record the police stop you now and then. Demanding: everything weighs half again as much and, where you are avoided, some shops won't serve you. What you choose yourself, such as a permanent contract, a degree, a loan or upgrading a business, is always available, at any level. On an online server it doesn't apply.

You have to eat, drink, sleep and wash. With hunger, thirst or sleepiness you move slower and aim worse, and if you ignore them you lose health. You drink at bars, stores and in your kitchen; the shower is at your home or in a hotel. Being dirty lowers your mood. The V key tells you how you are doing, and Shift V, only that. Jugando sin conexión, conquistar no es e: Playing offline, conquering is not the end: when you hold all the neighborhoods of a city, or many without holding them all, the defeated gangs regroup and, after a few quiet days, try to take them back. They warn you of the assault and you have a few hours to go defend the neighborhood in person or to send your people from the phone; if you do nothing, you lose it. You prepare on the phone, in Territories, Defense of your neighborhoods: guards, reinforcements, informants, truces and strikes on their hideouts. Choose how hard they push: off, and nobody contests them this way; calm, with few assaults and {entero} hours to respond; normal, which is the default, with {entero2} hours; or hard, with more frequent, stronger assaults and {entero3} hours. There are never two assaults at once. On an online server and when playing with friends it doesn't happen.
